#  11385 - Electromechanical Systems Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **11385 - Phase-out Module**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Electromechanical Systems**  |  
|  Elektromechanische Systeme   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 1 - Mathematics, Computer Science, Physics, Electrical Engineering and Information Technology   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Prof. Dr.-Ing. habil. Mussenbrock, Thomas 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  On special announcement   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | Development of a fundamental understanding for electromechanical interactions and systems and their underlying physical concepts. Students learn and explore the mathematical and physical basics to describe and model electromechanical systems.  |  
| Contents:  | The class comprises all basic ideas of electromechanical systems, including the description of mechanical and acoustical systems via electromechanical networks. The main topics are: 
  * Fundamentals of electrical and magnetical interaction,
  * electrostatic and piezoelectric transducer,
  * electromagnetic-, electrodynamic-, and piezomagnetic transducer.

For selected electromechanic systems, the design process, the fabrication techniques including microfabrication, modelling via finite element analysis, and characterization will be discussed in detail. Standard engineering software tools (e.g. Matlab, SPICE, Mathematica, ANSYS, LabView) will be used to explore various examples and applications of electromechanical systems.  |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | Knowledge of modules:
  * 33102 Elektrotechnik I: Gleichstromtechnik und Felder
  * 33103 Elektrotechnik II: Wechselstromtechnik
  * 31102 Technische Mechanik 1: Statik und Festigkeitslehre
  * 31105 Technische Mechanik 2: Dynamik

 |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | none  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Lecture / 2 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Exercise / 1 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 135 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | After each class, all figures shown are provided to the students via internet. These figures are intended to be used for completion of student’s written notes from class.Recommended literature:
  1. A. Lenk, G. Pfeifer, R. Werthschützky: Elektromechanische Systeme. Springer, 2001
  2. Giancoli: Physik, Lehr und Übungsbuch, 3. Auflage, Pearson Studium Verlag.
  3. Bergmann/Schäfer: Experimentalphysik, Band 2, Elektromagnetismus, Walter de Gruyter Verlag.

 |  
| Module Examination:  | Final Module Examination (MAP)  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | 
  * Oral examination, 45 min.

 |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * Abschluss im Ausland / Elektrotechnik / keine PO 
  * Abschluss im Ausland / Maschinenbau / keine PO 

 |  
| Remarks:  | None  |  
| Module Components:  | 
  * Electromechanical Systems (lecture)
  * Electromechanical Systems (exercise)

 |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Follow-up Module/s:  |  Phase-out module since: 08.02.2018 
  * without Follow-up Module/s

 |
